verify.rule: Re-run every number an assistant produced from the data, in your own code, before it enters a draft.
Read and run any code an assistant wrote before its output is used; keep the run.
Check every claim about a method or a source against the source itself.

disclose.rule: Every deliverable with assisted content carries a disclosure line: which tool, which parts, who verified them.
Tell the reviewer which parts were assisted before the review starts.

keep.rule: Keep the prompts and the assistant's outputs with the analysis, in the repository.
Keep a verification record: each assisted number, its re-run value and who re-ran it.

data.rule: Only data classified public, or anonymised under the data protection officer's rule, may be sent to a hosted assistant.
Use only assistants on the authority's approved list.

unaided.rule: Each analyst does one analysis a quarter without an assistant, reviewed like any other.
